# Vendored x402 Permit2 proxy

`x402BasePermit2Proxy.sol`, `x402ExactPermit2Proxy.sol` and
`interfaces/ISignatureTransfer.sol` are copied unchanged from
[x402-foundation/x402](https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402)
`contracts/evm/src` at tag `go/v2.29.0` (commit
`e4a086819f419e9395acbbdc1679fe6627029ff7`), MIT licensed. They match the
x402 Go SDK `go/v2.29.0` that the demo uses. Do not edit them; update them
together with the SDK.
